notes: Deterministic comms text (GDD 5.2, 15.2): used when the AI times out, fails validation, or is not needed. No digits anywhere: values only enter through {fact}, which becomes a <FACT:id> token that the client resolves from the speaker's own observations. Placeholders: {name} crew member's short name, {task} task title, {action} action title, {label} fact label, {fact} fact value token, {value} a value in words and {count} a count in words (spoken read-outs only: what text-to-speech says, while the transcript lists every value).

lines.interpret_failed: Sorry, I didn't get that. Say again, or use a quick command.
lines.cannot_verify: I can't verify that. Can you put it another way?
lines.unknown_answer: I haven't checked that myself. Want me to take a look?
lines.unknown_fact_answer: I'd have to check {label} first. Want me to take a read?
lines.action_offer_question: Your call. Want us to go ahead?
lines.task_failed: {task} didn't go as planned. Let me look at what happened.
lines.busy_crew: I'm still on {task}. Say stop if you want me to drop it.
lines.request_held_system: Connection lost. Your request is on hold and will be sent when the link is back.
lines.connection_lost_system: Connection to crew systems lost. Mission frozen.
lines.voice_failed_system: Voice transcription failed. Try again or type the order.
lines.voice_empty_system: Nothing was heard. Hold the talk key while speaking.
lines.frozen_system: Mission frozen. Your request will go out when it resumes.
